---
title: "Learn Python (from Go)"
---

A hands-on Python course for developers coming from Go. Each chapter renders one
self-contained exercise from the repo — narrative alongside the actual source code
and its printed output.

If you already write Go, you know static typing, interfaces, goroutines, and
explicit error handling. This course focuses on where Python diverges: dynamic
typing, duck typing, generators, decorators, comprehensions, and the patterns that
make idiomatic Python feel very different from idiomatic Go. Where a Go comparison
clarifies a concept, we draw the parallel directly.

This book is for reading. To practice, run the exercises directly:

```bash
python3 01_fundamentals/01_hello.py
```

Every file also works as a debug target in your editor, exactly as if this book
didn't exist.
